provenance.prompt: Use Sable Regent's supplied portrait and gameplay sprite as exact identity/style references. Create an original transparent RGBA 1536×1024 sprite sheet with exactly four distinct complete full-body Sable basketball receive poses in a 2-column by 2-row grid, row-major. Same warm-brown athletic adult human woman, individual face, black gathered hair with red headband, black/crimson/white Blackthorn kit, wristbands; preserve anatomy, silhouette and palette. One character per cell, facing right. No ball, teammate, hoop, court, shadow or prop: the basketball is separate at runtime. Four-frame receive: 0 look up and extend both empty hands to meet a descending pass; 1 raise hands farther, adjust stance; 2 catch-anchor pose with both hands cupped together at chest/face level around the invisible ball (grab frame2); 3 secure the invisible ball against chest and stabilize. Clearly distinct phases, natural human hands, complete hair/body/shoes fully in each cell with broad margins. Crisp limited-palette 1990s arcade sprite, dark outlines, no glossy/painterly/3D treatment. True alpha-zero background, no checkerboard/matte. Return only the sprite sheet.

ballTrack.notes: Descending separate pass meets both hands on catch frame2; settle at chest on frame3.

review.reviewNotes: Four distinct complete receive poses; both empty hands reach up and frame2 catch pose is clear; identity consistent, no embedded ball.
